print: Print is black on white with the drawing at full width and legible labels, but the source footer is printed mid-page over the chamber Barrel table header.
summary: All 25 drawings are true-to-scale cartridges of the right family (rimless, rimmed, belted, rimfire, bottleneck or straight) with outside view, hatched section with primer pocket, brief-conform bullets and values that match the records. Recurring weaknesses are the shoulder angle shown only as a leader label and all diameter dimensions stacked right of the bullet with long extension lines; on three revolver cases the missing-groove note is struck through by the title block frame.
